channel.description: A personal daily news briefing, read aloud.

item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 30 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: fifteen to twenty-two, showers, eight and a half millimetres of rain, so that is a proper umbrella, not a decorative one. Tomorrow, the first of October, the high drops to nineteen. Then it dries out, and every day to Monday tops out at twenty or under. Watch…

item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 07 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: nine to fourteen, wet from breakfast to bedtime, twenty-five point two millimetres. Coat, boots, and a face like a wet Monday. Rain is on a split shift: today and Friday on, everything else off. Thursday is bone dry. Friday is the odd one out: the warmest day at…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 29 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: sixteen to twenty-five, partly cloudy, three millimetres of rain, so a shirt and an umbrella in the same bag. Wednesday is the wet one: nearly seventeen millimetres, still warm at twenty-three. Then the forecast gives up entirely. Thursday, Friday, Saturday,…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 06 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: thirteen to twenty, cloudy, four point six millimetres of rain. A warm-up act. Wednesday is the headliner: eighty-two point eight millimetres. That is not rain, that is a reservoir changing address, and the high drops to fifteen to match. Trainers on Wednesday?…

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 08 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: seven to fourteen, rain, six point four millimetres. Coat on, and no, those trainers are not waterproof, I have seen them. Friday is the wetter one, ten point one millimetres, mild at ten to eighteen, wind to nine metres a second, so your hair files a complaint.…

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 01 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: twelve to nineteen, partly cloudy, seven tenths of a millimetre of rain. That is not rain, that is a rumour. Leave the umbrella; you will carry it anyway, because you are that man. It is also the first of October, the day gas bills jump a third on April, so…

item.title: Briefing — Sunday 27 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: thirteen to twenty-three degrees, partly cloudy, two point four millimetres of rain — trivial, leave the big coat at home. Monday cools to ten to nineteen, dry. Then Tuesday, for no reason anyone bothered to explain, rockets to twenty-six degrees, six or seven…

item.title: Briefing — Monday 28 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: eleven to nineteen degrees, partly cloudy, bone dry — mild and unremarkable, make the most of it. Tuesday jumps to a top of twenty-five but charges you nineteen millimetres of rain for the privilege. Wednesday is the one to actually dress for: still warm,…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 25 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Remember Monday, the day forecast last week to drown the whole run under fourteen millimetres of rain? It has since been revised right down to zero, the driest day of the week now, not the wettest — that is what a five-day outlook is worth. The dry run actually breaks…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 09 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: eleven to eighteen degrees, nine point four millimetres of rain, wind up to nine metres a second. Waterproofs. Not those trainers, I have seen them and they are a cry for help. Saturday is nearly dry, Sunday damp and dawning at seven degrees, so layers. Then the…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 02 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: twelve to twenty, partly cloudy, and bone dry. Zero rain. You have no excuses and you know it. Saturday drips one point three millimetres, which is not weather, that is a cloud sneezing, so the plans stay on. Sunday: dry, twenty, the day every job you have been…
